Vendored from huggingface/candle at `1e6aa85e867eb007cba1b8bae517a10d1aaf0c0d` (candle-nn 0.10.2). The standalone manifest expands upstream workspace dependencies. SceneWorks adds an optional typed projection operation to VarBuilder and Linear so model constructors can consume checkpoint-native weights. `VarBuilder` `TensorInfo` also carries the tensor's stored `dtype` when the backend knows it from a header (SW-7285), so loaders can classify stored GGML block tensors before choosing a quantized or dense read.
